main_text.p: A. C. 1580 Franciscus Draco Anglus regnum quoddam Barbarum detexit, quod Novam Albionem vocavit sed ab eo tempore nihil de eo certi cognitum fuit.
main_text.head: AUSTRALIS.
Canon.
main_text.p: III. Auftra-lis.Australis terra nondum detecta est.

Restat adhuc ingens Orbis pars versus Meridiem, cujus litora quidem & ignes procul à navigantibus conspiciuntur, ingredi autem, nisi interdum aquandi ergo, propter incolarum ferociam, non audent Quidam Hispanus nomine Petrus Ferdinandus del Quier, A. C. 1617 Regi Hispaniae accuratam, ut jactabat, earum terrarum descriptionem exhibuit, ibiq; immensam auri argenti-

page.notes: Catchword "que" is the start of the next line ("argentique"), printed at lower right. The printed word "argenti-" keeps its hyphen. The "III." caput number exists only in the margin, so the heading has no caput attribute. "Explic." is treated as a closing rubric, not a heading. Old-style figures in "1580" are copied as 1580. Lines near the right edge of the scan are slightly cropped, but all text was legible.
